services.name: Custom Tours
services.desc: Come explore beautiful Woods Hole and the surrounding islands of Cape Cod! Duration 2 - 4 Hours About Woods Hole Island Tours offers water adventures surrounding the Elizabeth Islands and Martha's Vineyard. Board the Eagle's Wing, our Rigid Hull Inflatable Boat (R.I.B), for a fast, fun, and unique experience. We are able to offer private charters to groups of up to 6 people. This allows each passenger the opportunity to engage with the Captain, ask questions, and make special requests. Build your custom tour to include: Island Hopping, Sunset Cruises, Booze Cruises, Picnics, Beach Excursions, Sightseeing, Swimming & Snorkeling, Special Events, Office Parties, Weddings​, Bereavements, etc.
